source: CAD-owned general geometry identities. Project input comes from authenticated current engineering source only.

rules.title: Theoretical steel mass, not bar bending schedule
rules.formula: unit kg/m = (π/4) × (diameter_mm/1000)^2 × density_kg/m³; total kg = unit kg/m × accepted bar count × accepted cut length_m

rules.title: Gross rectangular volume
rules.formula: L_m × B_m × H_m = gross m³; net result requires verified shape and deductions

rules.title: Cement bag math (source-accepted dosage only)
rules.formula: volume_m³ × approved dosage_kg/m³ / verified bag_kg; no arbitrary mix dosage

rules.title: Stirrups, hoops, dowels and bars
rules.reason: NO UNIVERSAL CUT LENGTH. Require accepted member geometry, bar shape, cover, hook angle/length, bend allowances, lap and development, source detail ID.

rules.title: Excavation and backfill
rules.formula: Net measured boundaries and cut/fill volume by accepted geometry; no default depth, bulking or batter
